findings.basis: OWASP Regular Expression Denial of Service Prevention
findings.remediation: Use bounded, allowlisted patterns and enforce input and execution limits for dynamic regular expressions.

findings.message: uses eval() or new Function() to execute dynamically generated code

findings.attack_vector: Source uses eval()/new Function(); this rule alone does not prove that an attacker controls the evaluated value.
